answer: The sonnet counter is kept in sparrow and ripple reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 31 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 31 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 326 aliases cost 149 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
